profile.facility_note: Advanced Operations Center, Twin Cities East Bank campus, Minneapolis. 34,000 gross sq ft, 12,000 sq ft data hall. $72.75M budget. Construction began Aug 2024, projected completion Aug 2026 per UMN Capital Project Management.

reading: The University of Minnesota is building the Advanced Operations Center, a 34,000 gross square foot data infrastructure facility on its Twin Cities East Bank campus in Minneapolis, Hennepin County, positioned at the north end of parking lot C33 northwest of Huntington Bank Stadium. According to the university's own capital project management office, the building will include 12,000 square feet of network and data hall space along with supporting areas for testing, configuration, and equipment management, at a total project budget of 72.75 million dollars. Construction began in August 2024 with DLR Group as architect and McGough Construction as general contractor, and the university's own materials projected completion around August 2026. The project is intended to modernize and consolidate the university's core network operations infrastructure. As a university owned enterprise facility built to support the school's own IT and network operations rather than to offer commercial colocation or cloud services, the Advanced Operations Center should be understood as institutional infrastructure serving the University of Minnesota's Twin Cities campus and broader system, not as a facility available to outside tenants. Because this research was conducted close to the facility's planned 2026 completion date, its final operational status as of this writing was not independently confirmed beyond the university's published project timeline.
